text: **cleverer-dsh**（DSH 插件，适用于 DSH 的通用客户端）：一套把执行纪律和实用工具接入 DSH 的插件。它通过 Cordis 事件钩子与工具注册实现失败重试拦截、方案级错误溯源、多步骤任务规划提醒和系统提示纪律；还提供跨会话记忆、从失败经验沉淀技能、按需加载内置技能、动态插件生命周期约束、并行文件查找和环境诊断。适合希望减少盲目重试、保存长期上下文并快速检查项目文件或运行环境的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API key；需要已初始化的 DSH，插件管理器安装需要 pnpm。

cleverer-dsh adds rules and tools to DSH. It checks repeated failures, prompts root-cause review and planning, stores cross-session memory, and loads or learns skills. It provides file search and environment checks. No API key is needed; install through DSH's plugin manager with pnpm.

**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「重复失败拦截」：记录失败工具调用指纹；相同调用达到阈值后拒绝再次执行，并可注入反思提醒。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「错误溯源」：汇总不同工具或方案的失败，在后续步骤给出定位根因、停止绕圈或复盘的提醒。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「规划提醒」：识别用户请求中的多步骤信号；当前 turn 没有 todo 时，提醒先建立并更新任务清单。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「跨会话记忆」：memory 工具支持列出、新增、替换和删除条目，并在新 turn 注入记忆快照。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「技能沉淀」：观察失败后成功的工具路径，在 turn 结束时将合格经验并入现有技能或保存为新技能。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「按需加载技能」：在会话开始列出技能触发条件，并根据用户消息中的关键词点名对应技能。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「并行文件查找」：fast_locate 同时扫描多个根目录，按 glob 或路径子串匹配并返回文件和目录结果。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「环境诊断」：env_check 可运行随包诊断脚本，按检查项返回环境问题的结果文本。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「动态插件生命周期提醒」：为 cordis 工具注入纪律，并在执行前检查 define、run、stop 与 undefine 的顺序。
**cleverer-dsh** 的功能「执行纪律提示」：注册系统提示章节，强调交付真实产物、如实报告失败、先查原因并验证结果。

cleverer-dsh README · What it fixes：DSH is full-featured but **not smart by default**: empty system prompt, stubborn retries on failure, skills installed but never used, todo tool ignored. This suite fixes it:

cleverer-dsh README · What it fixes：| Layer | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Discipline layer** (8 plugins) | failure interception, forced reflection, task planning, memory dedup |
| **Hub** (discipline-hub) | shared failure log + reminder throttling — plugins don't collide, issues are traceable |
| **Tools layer** (2 plugins) | instant file lookup, env health check |
| **Skill layer** (6 skills) | on-demand auto-loading — know what to do on errors, find things fast |

cleverer-dsh README · Installation：**Prerequisites**: DSH installed and initialized; `pnpm` available (DSH's plugin manager).

**Choose before you install** — the two options differ in how plugins are organized:

cleverer-dsh README · Installation：| | Option 1: plugin manager (official) | Option 2: script install |
|---|---|---|
| Command | `dsh plugin add ...` | paste one PowerShell line |
| Plugin organization | all plugins in one inline config | grouped into `discipline-board` (discipline) + `tools-board` (tools) boards |
| Plugin cooperation | plugins work independently | **stronger** — discipline plugins share one failure log & reminder pipeline, working as one suite |

cleverer-dsh README · Installation：> 💡 **Why boards are the better architecture**: the plugins are not meant to work in isolation — one traces the root cause, one distills the lesson, one reminds you to plan. Boards make this cooperation a **structural guarantee** (plugins belong to the same group and share the same facilities by construction) instead of leaving it to chance. Discipline and tools are physically separated with clear boundaries, so adding your own plugin later has an obvious home; groups start/stop as a whole, which makes upgrades and troubleshooting simpler.

cleverer-dsh README · Plugins：| Plugin | Problem it solves | When it triggers |
|---|---|---|
| `anti-stuck` | stubbornly retrying the same failing command | ≥2 same-arg fails → deny; ≥3 turn fails → remind; ≥5 → force reflection |
| `dsh-env-triage` | param-tweaking loops, going in circles | ≥2 schemes fail → trace card; ≥3 → stop & report |
| `dsh-plan-discipline` | todo tool ignored | multi-step task without plan → remind; ≥3 fails & stale plan → refresh |
| `dsh-memory` | memory bloat, force-write abuse | dedup before write + 60s window dedup |
| `skill-evolver` | junk skills being saved | generalization gate before persisting |
| `dsh-discipline` | empty system prompt | injects 11 execution rules every turn |
| `dsh-skill-loader` | skills installed but never used | available-skills reminder at task start + keyword summoning |
| `dsh-cordis-discipline` | dynamic-plugin misuse | precondition checks (no run before define, no undefine before stop) |
| `discipline-hub` | plugins each doing their own thing, reminder spam | unified failure log + reminder throttle |
| `dsh-fast-locate` | slow file lookup | one call, parallel multi-directory scan |
